children.title: Prepare context setup
children.instructions: Confirm the context Git worktree and project-local facts required by WORKFLOW.md and KNOWLEDGE.md.
children.deliverables: Context setup inputs recorded in the blackboard and setup artifacts.
children.acceptance: The context worktree is independent from the business repository and required project-local facts are available or gated.

children.title: Finalize context setup
children.instructions: Verify WORKFLOW.md and KNOWLEDGE.md through xc-document and record both as setup artifacts.
children.acceptance: Both context documents validate and their document-evolution subtrees are complete.
